brief: Explain the consequence of a missed payment using the agreement’s stated terms.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Read the missed-payment terms"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Lee las consecuencias del atraso"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Leia as regras do atraso"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Explain the consequence of a missed payment using the agreement’s stated terms.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A missed payment has the consequences stated in the applicable agreement and rules.
instruction.misconception: Every late payment triggers the same fee, grace period or collateral consequence in every agreement.
instruction.numeracy_support: Every quantity and assumption needed to decide is visible in the current scenario. Examples explain the relationship before independent application.

evidence.reasoning: This fictional agreement charges a late fee after its deadline. Missing that deadline triggers the stated fee, not invented consequences.
The unpaid balance passed the stated fee-triggering deadline.
The payment arrived within the agreement’s stated window.
A late-fee clause alone does not establish immediate full repayment.
The old waiver does not change the new stated terms.
The stated trigger depends on receipt, not intention.
The clause states a delivery pause, not automatic ownership transfer.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
